videos.description:
You think you miss them. The good morning text. The late-night call. The weekend dates. But what you really miss is the person you thought you’d be with them.

In this episode, Jay Shetty talks about what to do when you just can’t get over your ex. Even if the breakup was years ago.

Jay explains why a breakup can hurt like withdrawal. He breaks down four myths that keep you stuck, starting with the idea that time heals everything. And he shares what happened when a client finally got the answer they begged their ex for.

Learn why hoping they’ll come back can turn into another heartbreak. And learn the one question that helps you start letting go.
